newsitem.title: USA: Teens with Satanic links sought in Florida murder.
newsitem.headline: Teens with Satanic links sought in Florida murder.

text.p: A central Florida couple was found beaten to death in their home and authorities were searching Wednesday for their missing 15-year-old daughter, who is suspected of having links to a group of Satanists.

Police want to question Heather Wendorf, who disappeared with four other teens after the slaying of her parents, Richard, 49, and Ruth Wendorf, 54. The bodies of the parents were discovered by police late Monday in their home in Eustis, Fla., about 25 miles north of Orlando.
It was unclear whether the girl was kidnapped or went willingly with the friends, who included two teenagers charged in Kentucky with tearing the legs off a dog in a bizarre ritual, police said.
The Wendorf's eldest daughter, Jennifer, 17, discovered her parents' bodies late Monday. Deputies found an abandoned Buick used by one of the Kentucky teens ditched in central Florida.
Lake County sheriff's spokesman Chris Daniels told Reuters there was no sign of a struggle inside the Wendorf home. Both appeared to have died from beatings, police said.
